findings.title: Invalid ERB syntax renders the embed/best template unusable
findings.body: The tag `<%- end if %>` is not valid Ruby/ERB. ERB compiles the tag body as `end if`, which is a Ruby syntax error. Rendering `EmbedController#best` for an existing topic will raise a SyntaxError or ActionView::Template::Error instead of returning the comments, breaking the embed feature. The tag should be `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: Unsanitized embed_url in imported HTML footer allows stored XSS
findings.body: `embed_url` is interpolated directly into an HTML string using `I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}")`, with no HTML escaping. `url` is ultimately user-influenced (passed from `EmbedController#best` through the retrieve job, with only a prefix check for http/https) and is later stored and rendered with `cook_method` raw_html and `raw post.cooked` in the embed view. A URL such as `http://eviltrout.com/'>` becomes executable HTML in the post, giving stored XSS for anyone viewing the embedded topic. Escape `url` (e.g. with `ERB::Util.html_escape`) before building the footer.

findings.title: Unescaped referer is injected into JavaScript targetOrigin
findings.body: `request.referer` is interpolated directly into a JavaScript string inside a `<script>` block without `j`/`escape_javascript`/HTML escaping. Although `ensure_embeddable` validates only the referer's host, the rest of the URL can contain quotes or `</script>`. A referer such as `http://eviltrout.com/foo'></script><script>alert(document.cookie)</script>` would break out of the script and execute in the Discourse embed page. Escape the referer or derive the target origin from configuration rather than embedding the raw header.

findings.title: PollFeed assumes every RSS item has a content field
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` calls `String#scrub` on `i.content` unconditionally. RSS/Atom feeds commonly store the body in `description`/`summary` (or omit it for titles-only items); when `content` is nil, this raises `NoMethodError: undefined method 'scrub' for nil:NilClass`, aborting the entire poll before later items are processed. Use `(i.content || i.description || '')` (or equivalent per feed format) and guard nil.
